title: Re-roll: a bolder hand for the Fresh Fingers landing page
question: Bolder register. The deal leads with A Day in Section. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: A Day in Section
options.lineage: Architects' daylight sections: one long cut through a building, the sunbeam travelling through rooms with time stamps
options.thesis: The page is one continuous section through a single day; a travelling band of light moves from 08:12 coffee to 23:40 club, and every room it reaches is a Fresh Fingers moment.
options.viewport: Bright limewash page cut as an architectural section: a horizontal charcoal ground line with rooms drawn above it; huge lowercase-free caps FRESH WHEN YOU NEED IT. set as the building's title with tabular time stamps 08:12 · 13:00 · 18:30 · 23:40 pinned beside each room; a gold light band crossing the first room where the Fresh Fingers pack stands; four rooms in four brand colours further along the section; 'Pobierz deck' and 'Kontakt' pinned as annotations in the margin.
options.risk: Reads like an architecture studio if the rooms stay empty; the packs and moments must inhabit every room.

raised.raise: The headline draws itself as one continuous stroke on load, never a fade.
The section is one unbroken horizontal line that never wraps; a running 'now' marker always shows where the light is.
Palette law: each brand owns exactly its colours and nothing on the page is off-palette.

options.label: Foundation Workshop
options.lineage: Bauhaus Vorkurs: primary circle, square, triangle tested as material exercises on white tables
options.thesis: Four brands as four primary forms on a white worktable; every section is one compositional exercise you can push around.
options.viewport: White field with a faint baseline grid; a huge blue square, red circle, lime triangle and navy bar arranged off-centre like instruments on a table, each holding its pack; the headline in single-case geometric sans 'fresh when you need it.' running along one rule; small ink labels name the brands; 'pobierz deck' as a black ink button on the rule.
options.case: Beats the leader on product clarity (packs as planes on white read in one second) and holds audience identification as premium design canon; loses the 'moment' story the leader tells.
options.risk: Can read as a design-school exercise unless the packs, not the shapes, are the subject.

options.label: Polska Szkoła Plakatu
options.lineage: The Polish poster school: one painted metaphor swallowing the sheet, hand-lettered title bent to the image
options.thesis: One painted metaphor per section, a mouth that is also a city at night, a smile that is also a doorway; the title lettered by the same brush.
options.viewport: A single painted image fills the viewport: a huge open smile whose teeth are a row of four packs in four colours; FRESH WHEN YOU NEED IT. hand-lettered along the lip line; the Polish subline painted small in a corner; 'Pobierz deck' as a painted stamp.
options.case: Wins audience identification outright for a Polish company and gives the illustration you asked for; loses product clarity when the metaphor swallows the pack.
options.risk: Art over information: partners need the pack to read in three seconds.

options.label: Hand-Bent Neon Circuit
options.lineage: Neon fabrication: one continuous glass stroke, gas, electrodes
options.thesis: The brand as one continuous lit stroke.
options.viewport: One continuous cobalt script across a dark room.
options.case: Loses both axes after your steer: it needs a dark room, and a single glow colour cannot carry four brands.
options.kept: Headline draws itself as one continuous stroke.

options.label: Rhythm Machine Step Row
options.lineage: Early-80s drum machine: sixteen candy step keys under a chase light
options.thesis: The day as a sixteen-step pattern.
options.viewport: One unbroken step row across the page.
options.risk: Charcoal panel is another dark ground.
options.case: Loses both axes: a charcoal instrument panel is dark, and a step sequencer is a gimmick for this audience.
options.kept: One unbroken line that never wraps, with a running 'now' marker.

options.label: CRT Arcade Pixel Glow
options.lineage: Pixel-art arcade cabinets: fat pixels, scanlines, phosphor
options.thesis: The brand as a sprite on a phosphor stage.
options.viewport: A tile-grid playfield with score at the top.
options.case: Loses both axes: dark, and retro-gaming is not a partner or investor's world.
options.kept: Strict palette law: each brand owns its colours; nothing off-palette.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The DTC oral-care page: white ground, pack hero, benefit icons, brand grid, contact strip; executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, pack right, four brand tiles below, benefits row, download deck and contact at the end.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every oral-care brand by design.
